title: Galaxy Watch4 series (WearOS3) complications not working in follower/broadcast mode
symptom: On Galaxy Watch4 classic, when using the 'xDrip+ complication provider', it always shows 'null / null' or '/null'. All default xDrip+ watchfaces work fine, but the complication provider doesn't. For 'G6 Native' datasource everything works fine, but with build-your-own-dexcom-app and datasource set to '640G/Eversense', complications fail.
evidence_quote: If I'm using the "xDrip+ complication provider" it always shows "null / null" or "/null". I'm using build-your-own-dexcom-app to recieve my values, xDrip+ datasource is set to "640G/Eversense". All default xDrip+ watchfaces are working fine just the complication provider isn't.
